result.title: RemoteEvolver: Expanding Earth Observation Capabilities through Agent Harness Evolution
result.summary: We are interested in developing a continually self-improving remote sensing agentic system. It should identify and address its capability gaps, retaining the resulting improvements to enhance performance on subsequent tasks. However, existing systems typically rely on fixed toolsets and confine their experience accumulation to re-orchestrating predefined capabilities, constraining both capability expansion and the transfer of improvements across tasks. As the infrastructure for agentic systems, the harness manages tools and workflow knowledge as editable, persistent resources outside the base model. These resources can therefore be updated and reused across tasks without additional post-training. Based on these observations, we propose RemoteEvolver, an external harness for remote sensing agents that drives tool and workflow evolution through execution feedback. With the base model parameters fixed, RemoteEvolver acquires missing specialized tools on demand and distills verified successful execution experience from individual tasks into agent skills that can be reused across tasks. The acquired tools and accumulated skills jointly support planning and execution on subsequent tasks. Experiments on Earth-Bench and OpenEarthAgent-Bench show that RemoteEvolver achieves average accuracy gains of 8.18 and 23.86 percentage points over its initial state when tools are fully available and partially missing. Under the same settings, it also outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by an average of 6.77 and 17.10 percentage points, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RemoteEvolver：在基座模型参数固定的前提下，用一个外部 harness 依据执行反馈演化遥感智能体的工具与工作流，按需获取缺失工具并把已验证的执行经验蒸馏为可跨任务复用的技能，从而在后续任务中共同支撑规划与执行。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「识别能力缺口—按需调用工具—验证后沉淀技能」的循环，或可为 LVR 中何时补充视觉证据、如何复用成功轨迹提供问题表述上的启发；但该方法停留在 harness 层，不涉及 latent 状态表示与生成，借鉴价值需核查。
